recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中紅血球大小一致、有中央淡染區，幾乎沒有異形紅血球，可見 4 顆型態正常的分葉核嗜中性球與足量散在的血小板，屬於正常血液抹片。
features: Red cells uniform in size and shape, normocytic and normochromic with central pallor about one-third of the cell diameter
No significant poikilocytosis, polychromasia, spherocytes, schistocytes or target cells
Four morphologically normal segmented neutrophils with 3–5 lobes and pink cytoplasm
Adequate numbers of scattered platelets of normal size without clumping
Monolayer area with minimal red cell overlap, appropriate for morphologic review
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined in a well-spread monolayer, shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with normal central pallor and no significant anisopoikilocytosis. White cells present are morphologically normal segmented neutrophils without toxic change or hypersegmentation. Platelets are adequate in number and normal in size. Findings are consistent with a normal peripheral blood smear.
